cohort: The study included 36,630 children born in Tasmania, Australia, between July 2008 and June 2014, whose antenatal records were linked to health service use data up to 5 years of age.
finding: Children exposed to maternal smoking during pregnancy had a 26% higher rate of ED presentation and a 45% higher rate of admission through the ED up to 5 years of age, particularly for respiratory, eyes/ears/nose/throat, psychosocial, and infectious disease categories.
